title: nan
authors: Shakerian A.; Eghmazi A.; Goasdoué J.; Landry R.J.
key_contribution: Presents a blockchain-secured foot-mounted dual-IMU ZUPT-aided indoor navigation system for GNSS-denied environments with robotics/vehicle application relevance and experimental validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
